title: Calibrated, explainable machine learning on routine laboratory data to characterize diagnostic assignment patterns in rheumatic diseases: a retrospective study of 12,085 patients.
summary: Calibrated supervised models on routine laboratory data characterized diagnostic assignments across 12,085 rheumatology patients and reported disease-specific classification and feature patterns. The result is reported in BMC Rheumatology. Affiliation was not available in checked primary metadata; no organization is assigned. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material.
